In Texas Hold’em you need the five community cards (the flop, turn, and river) in addition to each player’s two hole cards to build the best possible five‑card hand. Since the community cards aren’t provided, there’s no way to compare the hands and decide who wins. If you can supply the board cards, I’ll gladly figure it out for you!
